basis: Explicit owner instruction to relax criteria and emphasize cost-benefit after seeing P04/P05 results
historical_policy: D001 v1; original protocol/assessor/results remain unchanged
hard_gates: archive compatibility and visible failure/error outcomes
complete declared applicable coverage and bounded collection
numeric_thresholds: review triggers, not automatic product vetoes
dispersion: quality warning interpreted with paired confidence, absolute effect, tails and host context
memory: explicit temporary versus retained payload/process-peak and concurrency review; no universal new allowance
existing_evidence_review: explicitly retrospective; no reclassification or new predeclared statistical pass
future_sampling: freeze v2 policy/review-plan hashes and all comparison inputs before samples; v1 assessor outputs remain separately labeled diagnostics
